{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only completed orders that are not refunded
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders in completed orders
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_in_completed)}")

# Check revenue values again
print(f"Sample revenue values in completed orders: {completed_orders['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any negative values or implausible values
print(f"Min revenue: {completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].min()}")
print(f"Max revenue: {completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].max()}")

# Final mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
